career_ladder.note: Promotion from Sub-Inspector to Police Inspector (Circle Inspector / CI) is based on seniority-cum-merit and departmental qualifying criteria under the Rajasthan Police Subordinate Service Rules, 1989. Subsequent promotions into the Rajasthan Police Service (RPS) cadre (Deputy SP to Additional SP) are conducted through Departmental Promotion Committees (DPC) convened by RPSC. Meritorious RPS officers are eligible for induction into the Indian Police Service (IPS) cadre under the IPS (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment comprises three consecutive stages: Written Competitive Examination (400 marks), Physical Efficiency Test (100 marks, qualifying with min. 50%), and Aptitude Test & Interview (50 marks). Final recommendation is made on aggregate marks of Written Examination and Interview (450 marks total), subject to securing min. 36% in interview and 45% in aggregate (relaxed to 30% and 40% for reserved categories).

financial_package.note: State-jurisdiction cadre under Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2017. As per Rajasthan state service conditions, direct recruits undergo 2 years of probation trainee service on a fixed monthly stipend of ₹26,500. Upon successful completion of probation, regular pay in Pay Matrix Level L-11 is drawn with entry basic pay of ₹37,800 plus DA, HRA, and police duty allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: RPSC Notification 08/EXAM/SI-PC/EP-I/2020-21 & Rajasthan Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2017 Schedule I
financial_package.estimate_note: Regular monthly salary after 2-year probation (during probation fixed pay is ₹26,500/month). Calculated at Level L-11 entry basic pay of ₹37,800 with standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025), state HRA of 9% (Z-class towns) to 18% (Jaipur/Jodhpur/Kota/Ajmer/Bikaner Y-class cities), washing and police conveyance allowances. In-hand reflects deductions for GPF/NPS, State Insurance (SI), and Rajasthan Government Health Scheme (RGHS).
official_perks: Cashless medical coverage across Rajasthan government and empanelled private hospitals under RGHS (Rajasthan Government Health Scheme)
Uniform and kit maintenance allowance for executive policing duty
Government police residential quarters / barrack accommodation subject to departmental pool availability
Conveyance / travel allowance for field investigations and official court appearances
Subsidized police canteen and mess facilities in police lines and battalion headquarters
Pension coverage under Rajasthan Civil Services Pension Rules (restored Old Pension Scheme benefits)

competition_benchmarks.note: Applicant, appearance, and vacancy statistics for the RPSC Sub-Inspector / Platoon Commander Combined Competitive Examination. For the 2021 recruitment cycle (Advt. 08/2020-21), 859 vacancies were notified across AP, IB, RAC, and MBC branches. A total of 3,83,097 candidates appeared in the written examination out of approximately 7.97 lakh registered applicants. 20,240 candidates qualified for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET), and 3,291 qualified for the final interview stage.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 928 (calculated: registered applicants ÷ notified vacancies; approx. 1 in 446 for appeared candidates)
